title: Invalidation experiments
description:
Check the "iterator invalidation" table by experiment, safely.

```
vector: after push_back that grew, data() moved: yes
vector: after push_back within capacity, data() moved: no
deque: push_back keeps references valid: yes
list: erase keeps other iterators valid: yes
```
hints: Comparing a saved pointer with a new one is fine; reading through the saved one would not be (lesson 2.03).
`deque::push_back` invalidates iterators but not references, which is a detail worth noting.
requirements: Compare addresses (`data()`, `&element`) before and after, never dereference an invalidated iterator.
Match each result with the table on cppreference's container page.
stretch: Show `std::unordered_map` keeping references valid across a rehash.
